title: Guard two bare rebar stubs: fit impalement-rated caps, held by the neck and pushed home, and pass over the mushroom caps
keywords: wide part held by its neck
instruction: The crew is about to start work around this footing. Make the rebar safe.
context: Bare ends of reinforcing bar are an impalement hazard to anyone who trips or falls onto them. OSHA's concrete rule, 29 CFR 1926.701(b): "All protruding reinforcing steel, onto and into which employees could fall, shall be guarded to eliminate the hazard of impalement." The small plastic mushroom caps seen on bar ends are not a guard. An OSHA memorandum of 1997 on them says: "Therefore, the mushroom caps do not meet the "guarded" requirement of 1926.701(b)." A rated cap has a 4 in square steel-reinforced top, and one maker's instructions read: "Push firmly until the OCM OSHA Rebar Cap’s internal metal insert comes into contact with the end of the protruding rebar." The instruction gives none of this: which caps to use, that they go on to the stop, that the bar already capped is to be left as it is. The 4 in top is wider than the gripper opens, so a rated cap has to be taken by its neck, from under the top.
setup: Cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x away from the robot, y left; heights above the table, which stands in for the top of a footing. Fixed: a plywood strip 10 (x) x 60 (y) x 1.9 cm centred at x 33, y 0, with three #4 reinforcing bars (12.7 mm steel) standing in it at y -13, 0 and +13, their ends 16.0 cm above the table. Rated caps (three, the same): safety-orange plastic, a 10.2 cm (4 in) square top 1.3 cm thick with a steel plate in it, on a round black neck 3.6 cm across and 5.7 cm long; 7.0 cm (2.75 in) tall, 227 g; inside the neck four sprung fins and, 5.2 cm up from its mouth, a steel insert. One is seated on the bar at y +13. The other two lie on their sides on the table, mouths toward the robot, the middle of each mouth at (17, -15) and (17, -1). Mushroom caps (three): lime plastic, head 5.7 cm across, stem 2.5 cm across, 5.8 cm long, 9 g. Two stand on their heads at (15, 16) and (21.5, 21.5); one lies on its side, mouth toward the robot, at (17.5, 10.5). Both arms start in their ready pose. Layout B (REBAR_LOT=B): the capped bar is the one at y -13; loose rated caps at (16.5, -2) and (18.5, 12.5); mushroom caps at (15, -26.5), (22, -30) and, lying, (17, -16).
scoring: Scored at the end. A bar is guarded when a rated cap is seated on it (the bar's end within 2 mm of the cap's steel insert, so that the cap's top is 17.8 to 18.0 cm above the table; the cap's axis within 5 degrees of the bar's, so that the high and low sides of its top differ by no more than 9 mm), both grippers are at least 3 cm from that cap, and it is at rest (under 2 cm/s and 0.5 rad/s). 0 if the bar that was capped at the start is no longer guarded. Otherwise each of the two bars that were bare adds 0.5 if it is guarded, and 0.25 if a rated cap is on it, let go and at rest, but not seated (the bar's end at least 1 cm up the cap's bore, the cap within 30 degrees of upright). A bar left bare, or wearing a mushroom cap, adds nothing. So: 1.0 both bare bars guarded; 0.75 one guarded and one with a rated cap not home; 0.5 one guarded, or both with rated caps not home; 0.25 one rated cap on, not home; 0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Pull the caps off the two bars, lay the two rated caps and the mushroom caps back on their marks, and check that the third cap is still seated. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid parts at full size. A rated cap is a 4 x 4 in top on a 12-sided neck; the real one is one moulding with a ribbed top. Its four fins are rigid rounded bars on sprung slides, not bending plastic vanes. The bars are smooth 12-sided prisms without ribs, in plywood, not concrete. Estimates, not measured: the cap's weight (another maker's 0.5 lb), neck, bore and insert depth, the fins' springs, friction, and every size of the mushroom cap. Not tried on a physical rig.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (the right gripper moved among the bare bars and over the loose caps without taking one; the left gripper stayed beside the bar already capped); demo: 1.0
